headword: {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}
reading: しょくむけいれきしょ
gloss: work history document; professional resume; CV

definitions.explanation: a document detailing professional experience and achievements, used for job applications

examples.japanese: {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I wrote my work history document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit your resume and work history document.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: The work history document is important for job hunting.

notes:
CONTRAST WITH {履歴書|りれきしょ}:
- ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧: Basic personal information, education, and employment dates (standard format)
- {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ}: Detailed description of job duties, achievements, and skills (free format)

JAPANESE JOB APPLICATION:
When changing jobs (⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧) in Japan, both documents are typically required. The ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧ uses a standardized format, while the {職務|しょくむ}{経歴|けいれき}{書|しょ} allows candidates to highlight their specific accomplishments.

FORMS:
⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧ (work history) is the abbreviated form.
